SELECT a.source_kind, a.principal_type, a.principal_id, a.principal_key, COALESCE(CASE a.principal_type WHEN 1 THEN u.display_name WHEN 2 THEN r.name WHEN 3 THEN d.name END, a.principal_id::text) AS label, a.permission, false AS proposed FROM ( SELECT 'SPACE' AS source_kind, principal_type, principal_id, principal_key, permission FROM kb_space_acl a WHERE space_id = #{spaceId} AND
UNION ALL SELECT 'DOCUMENT', principal_type, principal_id, principal_key, permission FROM kb_document_acl a WHERE doc_id = #{documentId} AND
LIMIT #{fetch} ) a LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON a.principal_type = 1 AND u.id = a.principal_id LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON a.principal_type = 2 AND r.id = a.principal_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON a.principal_type = 3 AND d.id = a.principal_id ORDER BY a.source_kind, a.principal_type, a.principal_id, a.permission

SELECT p.permission, (
OR (p.permission = 'manage' AND #{globalManage})) AS space_granted, (
OR (p.permission IN ('view','download','edit','comment') AND
)) AS document_granted FROM (VALUES ('view'),('download'),('edit'),('review'),('comment'),('manage')) p(permission) CROSS JOIN (SELECT CAST(#{documentId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AS bigint) AS id) d
